verdict.rationale: Namecheap's API uses a single global API key/username with full account access (no scoped tokens or per-agent least-privilege credentials) and requires IP whitelisting; evidence only shows generic API endpoint errors and unrelated RDAP/WHOIS/security community complaints. Missing for 10: any documentation of scoped API keys, OAuth-style tokens, role-based permissions, or agent-specific credential issuance.
